name: gauntlet-loop-local
description: Matt Shumer's Gauntlet Loop as an executable Workflow script: a builder and a fresh blind critic per round, A/B against a real reference exemplar, one gap back each time, no round cap.

plugins.name: gauntlet-loop
plugins.description: Improve an artifact until a blind judge picks it over a real reference. Builder plus fresh critic each round, positions split, unanimous exit, operator-held stop token.
